beats.narration_text: Hello, I'm Vineet S.. Launching an A I product is not one day. It is a staged path, and the work continues after launch.

props.segment: Launching an AI Product: From Beta to Production
props.command: How do I launch an AI product safely, from beta to production?
output: Start small with pilots and beta users
Roll out in stages, with rollback ready

beats.narration_text: From pilot to production. Pilot. Beta. A B testing. Staged rollout. Monitoring. And continuous improvement. Each stage lowers risk before the next one raises exposure.
Start small. A pilot with a friendly group, closely watched. Then a beta with real users. Set exit criteria in advance, so the decision is made on data, not on a feeling.

layers.title: Pilot
layers.sub: A small, friendly group, closely watched

layers.title: Beta
layers.sub: Real users, wider and less supervised

beats.narration_text: Then never stop improving. Review metrics weekly. Grow the test set from real problems. Revisit cost and model choice. And tell users what improved, because trust grows when they see progress.

layers.title: Grow the test set
layers.sub: Add real problems as new cases

layers.title: Tell users
layers.sub: Trust grows when they see progress
